chant.letra:
[Leader]
Big!
[Kids]
Small!

[Leader]
Long!
[Kids]
Short!

[Leader]
Old!
[Kids]
New!

[Leader]
Dirty!
[Kids]
Clean!

[Leader]
And how do we feel today?
[Kids]
Happy! Happy! Very happy!

[All]
Big and small and old and new —
kind and happy, me and you!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
The lighthouse is big, the puffin is small,
the road is long, the wall is short.
My shoes are old, my hat is new,
my hands are dirty — and yours are too!

[Chorus]
Big and small, long and short,
old and new and clean!
Happy, beautiful, young and kind —
say the word you mean!

[Verse 2]
A young girl sings a beautiful song,
an old man claps along.
A clean white boat, a dirty brown boot
and a happy little tune!

[Chorus]
Big and small, long and short,
old and new and clean!
Happy, beautiful, young and kind —
say the word you mean!

[Bridge]
Point at something big — point at something small!
Say the word and that is all!

[Chorus]
Big and small, long and short,
old and new and clean!
Happy, beautiful, young and kind —
say the word you mean!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Are you happy?
[Kids]
Yes, I am! I am happy!

[Leader]
Are you sad?
[Kids]
No, I'm not! I am fine!

[Leader]
Are you tired? Are you hungry?
[Kids]
I am tired! I am hungry!

[Leader]
Are you thirsty? Are you scared?
[Kids]
I am thirsty — but I'm not scared!

[All]
Happy, sad and angry, tired —
smile at me and we're all fine!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
I am happy, I am fine,
the sun is out and the day is mine.
Nico's tired, he did not sleep,
Astrid's hungry — that's no crime.

[Chorus]
Are you happy? Are you sad?
Tell me how you feel today!
I am fine, I am tired,
a smile can chase the grey away.

[Verse 2]
Freya's got a little headache,
Tomás has got a stomachache.
Rest a while and drink some water,
soon there'll be no ache to take.

[Chorus]
Are you happy? Are you sad?
Tell me how you feel today!
I am fine, I am tired,
a smile can chase the grey away.

[Bridge — soft]
If you cry, that's alright,
tell a friend and hold on tight.

[Chorus]
Are you happy? Are you sad?
Tell me how you feel today!
I am fine, I am tired,
a smile can chase the grey away.

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Can you jump?
[Kids]
Yes, I can! I can jump!

[Leader]
Can you swim?
[Kids]
Yes, I can! I can swim!

[Leader]
Can you fly?
[Kids]
No, I can't! I can't fly!

[Leader]
But who can fly?
[Kids]
Pip can fly! Pip can fly!

[All]
Jump and run and sing and dance —
I can, I can, give me a chance!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
I can run and I can jump,
I can climb a great big tree.
I can draw a yellow boat
and sing a song for you and me.

[Chorus]
I can, I can, I can't, I can't —
tell me what you can do!
Stand up, sit down, open, close,
now it's up to you!

[Verse 2]
I can't fly like Pip the puffin,
I can't swim as fast as fish.
But I can dance and I can laugh
and that's a pretty good wish.

[Chorus]
I can, I can, I can't, I can't —
tell me what you can do!
Stand up, sit down, open, close,
now it's up to you!

[Bridge]
Stand up! Sit down! Open! Close!
Do it fast from head to toes!

[Chorus]
I can, I can, I can't, I can't —
tell me what you can do!
Stand up, sit down, open, close,
now it's up to you!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Walk, walk, walk!
[Kids]
Walk, walk, walk!

[Leader]
Stop!
[Kids]
STOP!

[Leader]
Look and listen!
[Kids]
Look and listen!

[Leader]
Clap your hands and turn around!
[Kids]
Clap and turn! Clap and turn!

[All]
Walk, stop, look and listen, clap —
touch and point and stand and sit!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Walk with me and don't be slow,
stop the moment Astrid says so.
Look up high and listen well,
there's a story it will tell.

[Chorus]
Clap your hands and turn around,
touch your nose and point at me!
Stand up tall and sit back down —
follow me, one, two, three!

[Verse 2]
Nico walks and Tomás runs,
Freya stops and counts to four.
Pip is pointing with his beak
at a shell beside the door.

[Chorus]
Clap your hands and turn around,
touch your nose and point at me!
Stand up tall and sit back down —
follow me, one, two, three!

[Bridge]
Fast, fast — and now go slow!
Listen, look and off we go!

[Chorus]
Clap your hands and turn around,
touch your nose and point at me!
Stand up tall and sit back down —
follow me, one, two, three!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Where is the ball?
[Kids]
In the box! In the box!

[Leader]
Where is the hat?
[Kids]
On the chair! On the chair!

[Leader]
Where is the cat?
[Kids]
Under the table! Under the table!

[Leader]
Where is Pip?
[Kids]
Here! There! In the wardrobe!

[All]
In and on and under too —
where is it? It's up to you!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Put the ball in the big blue box,
put the hat on the wooden chair.
Look under the table, look under the bed,
something small is hiding there!

[Chorus]
In, on, under — where is it?
Here or there or everywhere!
Box and table, bed and sofa,
lamp and wardrobe, chair!

[Verse 2]
Astrid hides a little puzzle,
Nico counts to ten and looks.
It's not in the wardrobe, not on the lamp —
it's under a pile of books!

[Chorus]
In, on, under — where is it?
Here or there or everywhere!
Box and table, bed and sofa,
lamp and wardrobe, chair!

[Bridge]
Not on. Not in. Look again —
UNDER! There it is, my friend!

[Chorus]
In, on, under — where is it?
Here or there or everywhere!
Box and table, bed and sofa,
lamp and wardrobe, chair!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
What are you doing?
[Kids]
I am reading! I am reading!

[Leader]
What are you doing?
[Kids]
I am writing! I am writing!

[Leader]
What are you doing?
[Kids]
Drawing and painting! Drawing and painting!

[Leader]
And what do we all do here?
[Kids]
We learn! We learn! We learn together!

[All]
Read and write and draw and paint —
count and cut and glue and learn!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Astrid is reading a story out loud,
Nico is writing his name.
Freya is drawing a lighthouse in blue,
Tomás is painting the same.

[Chorus]
We read, we write, we draw, we paint,
we count and cut and glue!
Ask a question, give an answer —
that's how we learn, it's true!

[Verse 2]
Scissors cutting, glue is sticky,
paper flying everywhere.
Ask me something, I will answer,
learning here and learning there.

[Chorus]
We read, we write, we draw, we paint,
we count and cut and glue!
Ask a question, give an answer —
that's how we learn, it's true!

[Bridge]
What are you doing? Say it now:
I am learning — this is how!

[Chorus]
We read, we write, we draw, we paint,
we count and cut and glue!
Ask a question, give an answer —
that's how we learn, it's true!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Let's play football!
[Kids]
Football! Football! Kick the ball!

[Leader]
Let's play basketball!
[Kids]
Basketball! Up and in!

[Leader]
Let's play tennis!
[Kids]
Tennis! Tennis! Over the net!

[Leader]
And what are we together?
[Kids]
A team! A team! One big team!

[All]
Football, tennis, swimming, running —
play together, that's the fun!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
I play football after school,
Bruno kicks it hard and high.
Lía plays basketball in the yard,
the ball goes up into the sky.

[Chorus]
Let's play, let's play —
football, tennis, basketball!
Swimming, running, cycling too,
one big team, that's all!

[Verse 2]
Tino runs the fastest lap,
Iris scores the winning goal.
It doesn't matter if we win,
playing here is what we love.

[Chorus]
Let's play, let's play —
football, tennis, basketball!
Swimming, running, cycling too,
one big team, that's all!

[Bridge]
Ready? Steady? Off we go!
Pass the ball and don't be slow!

[Chorus]
Let's play, let's play —
football, tennis, basketball!
Swimming, running, cycling too,
one big team, that's all!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Let's go to the park!
[Kids]
To the park! To the park!

[Leader]
Let's go down the slide!
[Kids]
Down the slide! Whee!

[Leader]
Let's go on the swing!
[Kids]
On the swing! Up and up!

[Leader]
And what is next to the park?
[Kids]
The school! The library! The bus stop!

[All]
Slide and swing and tree and bench —
park and grass and lots of fun!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Let's go to the park, the sun is out,
there's a swing beneath the tallest tree.
A little bird is singing on the bench
and the grass is soft for you and me.

[Chorus]
Let's play, let's run,
down the slide and up again!
Park and flowers, tree and bench —
we'll stay until it's ten!

[Verse 2]
Past the school and past the library,
past the supermarket door.
The cinema is on the corner
and the bus stop's just before.

[Chorus]
Let's play, let's run,
down the slide and up again!
Park and flowers, tree and bench —
we'll stay until it's ten!

[Bridge]
Pick a flower, count the birds,
say the place without the words!

[Chorus]
Let's play, let's run,
down the slide and up again!
Park and flowers, tree and bench —
we'll stay until it's ten!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Stop!
[Kids]
STOP at the light!

[Leader]
Look!
[Kids]
LOOK to the left and right!

[Leader]
Listen!
[Kids]
LISTEN for a car!

[Leader]
Now cross!
[Kids]
Cross! Cross! Careful, careful!

[All]
Car and bus and bike and lorry —
cross the street and don't you worry!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
A red car and a yellow taxi,
a big blue bus goes by.
A lorry rumbles down the street
and a motorbike goes flying.

[Chorus]
Stop, look, listen, cross —
be careful, hold my hand!
Red light waits and green light goes,
that's how we understand!

[Verse 2]
Samu rides his little bike,
the shop is on the other side.
The train goes past behind the houses
and Aiko waves as we ride.

[Chorus]
Stop, look, listen, cross —
be careful, hold my hand!
Red light waits and green light goes,
that's how we understand!

[Bridge]
Never run and never hide,
walk across and hold on tight.

[Chorus]
Stop, look, listen, cross —
be careful, hold my hand!
Red light waits and green light goes,
that's how we understand!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
What's on the sand?
[Kids]
A shell! A shell! A little white shell!

[Leader]
What's in the sea?
[Kids]
Pip! Pip! Pip can swim!

[Leader]
What's on your head?
[Kids]
A hat! A hat! A big straw hat!

[Leader]
And what do we build?
[Kids]
A castle! A castle! A big sand castle!

[All]
Sun and sand and sea and shell —
ice cream day, we love it well!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
The sun is hot, the sand is gold,
we build a castle big and tall.
The sea comes in, the sea goes out
and takes a little of the wall.

[Chorus]
At the beach we swim and play,
we find a shell, we wear a hat.
Ice cream melting in the sun —
there's nothing better than that!

[Verse 2]
Freya swims and Nico digs,
Astrid counts the shells she's found.
Tomás runs into the waves
and Pip is sleeping on the ground.

[Chorus]
At the beach we swim and play,
we find a shell, we wear a hat.
Ice cream melting in the sun —
there's nothing better than that!

[Bridge]
Hot, hot, hot — into the sea!
Cool, cool, cool — come with me!

[Chorus]
At the beach we swim and play,
we find a shell, we wear a hat.
Ice cream melting in the sun —
there's nothing better than that!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
What's the weather? What's the weather?
[Kids]
It's sunny! It's sunny today!

[Leader]
What's the weather? What's the weather?
[Kids]
It's rainy! Get the umbrella!

[Leader]
What's the weather? What's the weather?
[Kids]
It's windy! Hold your hat!

[Leader]
Now look up — what can you see?
[Kids]
A rainbow! A rainbow in the sky!

[All]
Sunny, rainy, windy, cloudy —
hot or cold, we're going out!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
It's sunny today, the sky is wide,
the sea is bright and blue.
Tomorrow it is cloudy
and the wind comes rushing through.

[Chorus]
It's sunny, it's rainy,
it's windy, it's cold!
Take your umbrella, look at the sky —
a rainbow made of gold!

[Verse 2]
It's hot inside my woolly hat,
it's cold beside the door.
The rain is falling on the lighthouse,
seven colours, maybe more.

[Chorus]
It's sunny, it's rainy,
it's windy, it's cold!
Take your umbrella, look at the sky —
a rainbow made of gold!

[Bridge]
Look outside and tell me true:
what's the weather? How are you?

[Chorus]
It's sunny, it's rainy,
it's windy, it's cold!
Take your umbrella, look at the sky —
a rainbow made of gold!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
On Monday —
[Kids]
we go to school!

[Leader]
On Tuesday —
[Kids]
we play football!

[Leader]
On Wednesday —
[Kids]
we paint and draw!

[Leader]
On Thursday —
[Kids]
we read a book!

[Leader]
On Friday —
[Kids]
we sing a song!

[Leader]
And on Saturday and Sunday?
[Kids]
We rest! We play! We're free!

[All]
Seven days make one whole week —
today, tomorrow, here we go!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
On Monday Freya feeds the birds,
on Tuesday Nico kicks the ball.
On Wednesday Astrid paints a picture
and hangs it on the wall.

[Chorus]
Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday,
Thursday, Friday too!
Saturday and Sunday —
one week for me and you!

[Verse 2]
On Thursday Tomás climbs the hill,
on Friday everybody sings.
Today we run, tomorrow rest —
a week can hold a hundred things.

[Chorus]
Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday,
Thursday, Friday too!
Saturday and Sunday —
one week for me and you!

[Bridge]
What day is it? What day is it?
Say it now and don't forget!

[Chorus]
Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday,
Thursday, Friday too!
Saturday and Sunday —
one week for me and you!
